findings.summary: The Fan reply is correctly evidence-limited and no longer uses a possession template. However the “Checked against” line reads “Northbridge · % possession · Match so far through 57′” and the claim card lists possession figures (55.4% / 44.6%) as the only figures, which presents possession as the metric the take was checked against. This is the misleading possession wording the run required to be absent. The model also put its own gloss in claim.text (“…(adopted an extremely defensive, low-block approach)”), which the Fan reply quotes.
Analyst help text mentions a pass map for this claim (requiredEvidence includes passing) although the claim is not about passing.
